behaviors.description: Distinguish deployed commit from latest downloaded commit.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app commits A and B with runtime available.
behaviors.expected: Getter reports A after installation, B after download-only update while deployed commit stays A, and B after local deployment.

mappings.rationale: Known A/B commits separate download state from deployment state across three independently queried phases.

surface_assertions.rationale: Downloaded B is returned while the deployed commit is still A, then remains B after deployment.
